user.title: Set up Proscenic vacuum
user.description: Choose how to find your vacuum's local key.

menu_options.cloud: Log in with the Proscenic app account
menu_options.manual: Enter device ID and local key manually

cloud.title: Proscenic Cloud Login
cloud.description: Enter your {app_name} app credentials to automatically discover your vacuum and retrieve the local key. The credentials are only used during setup and are not stored.

select_device.title: Select Device
select_device.description: Select your Proscenic vacuum from the list of discovered devices.

device.title: Connection settings
device.description: Confirm the connection settings for {device_name}. Tuya devices found on your network are listed under IP Address; you can also type an address, for example from your router's list of connected devices.

manual.title: Manual Configuration
manual.description: Enter your vacuum's connection details manually. Tuya devices found on your network are listed under IP Address together with their device ID. You can obtain the local key with the tinytuya wizard.

reconfigure.title: Update device connection
reconfigure.description: Update LAN settings for {device_name}. Device ID (unchanged): {device_id}. Tuya devices found on your network are listed under IP Address.

progress.scan: Scanning your network for Tuya devices. This takes up to 12 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Please check the connection details and ensure the device is online.
error.no_devices: No devices found in your Proscenic account
